message: Albatross 0.4.0 is required and this version no longer connects. If the app does not update by itself: 1) Uninstall Albatross. 2) Download the new version with Get the update, or open https://github.com/cezomagoanlace29861-jpg/Albatross/releases/download/v0.4.0/Albatross-0.4.0-android.apk in your browser (Windows: Albatross-Setup-0.4.0.exe from https://github.com/cezomagoanlace29861-jpg/Albatross/releases/latest). 3) Install it and sign in with the username and password you were given. Later updates install from inside the app.
